## 2. Engineering Stack & Capabilities
- **Backend Architecture**:
  - Laravel 11, PHP 8.2+, REST APIs, Eloquent API Resources, Repository & Service Layer Patterns.
  - Spatie Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi-tenant tenancy structures, FormRequest input validation.
  - Asynchronous background jobs, queue processing (Redis / Database), database locking, and transaction isolation.
- **Frontend Architecture**:
  - Next.js (App Router, Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG)), React 19, TypeScript.
  - Tailwind CSS, Shadcn UI / Radix UI accessible component primitives, Framer Motion, GSAP animations.
  - Mobile responsiveness, 8pt spacing grid discipline, accessible focus rings, WCAG AAA contrast conformance.
- **Databases & Storage**:
  - PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis (caching and rate-limiting), Cloudflare R2 / AWS S3 asset storage.
- **AI Integration & Microservices**:
  - Python, FastAPI, Google Gemini API, OpenAI API, streaming conversational interfaces, WebSockets (Socket.IO).
- **Quality Assurance & DevOps**:
  - PHPUnit feature and unit tests, Postman API contract testing, Lighthouse performance auditing (100% Core Web Vitals).
  - Git version control, atomic commits, CI/CD with Vercel and GitHub Actions.
- **Discoverability & Optimization**:
  - Technical SEO, Local SEO, Schema.org JSON-LD (Person, WebSite, ProfessionalService, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, SoftwareApplication).
  - GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) for Perplexity, SearchGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.

## 3. Production Case Studies & Systems
### LMS Mastery (Enterprise Learning Management Platform)
- **Stack**: Laravel, MySQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS
- **Features**: Multi-role portal (SuperAdmin, Instructor, Student), dynamic quiz creation with automated grading, student enrollment management, and progress tracking.
- **Architecture**: Repository pattern isolating data persistence from controller logic; FormRequest validation; policy-based authorization.

### Hybrid IDS (Intrusion Detection System Dashboard)
- **Stack**: Python FastAPI, Next.js, WebSockets, Tailwind CSS
- **Features**: Real-time network telemetry analysis, anomaly detection visualization, and alert dispatching.

### MOU Store (Multi-Vendor E-Commerce Platform)
- **Stack**: Laravel, Next.js, Stripe & PayPal APIs, PostgreSQL
- **Features**: Atomic checkout flows, live inventory reservation, seller commission handling, and order lifecycle management.

### Restaurant ERP & POS System
- **Stack**: Laravel, Filament v3, MySQL, Livewire
- **Features**: Floor plan table management, kitchen display system (KDS), automated supply stock alerts, and multi-shift reporting.
